method: Local Chrome replay of the real 105-landmass map and 40 stationary ships, anonymized controllers, synthetic 10 Hz state stream and staggered flak projectiles; Apple M4 Pro via ANGLE Metal, no CPU/network throttling. Does not access or mutate live game state.
instrumentation: Local optional perf-log=1 CPU timers, compatible with existing metrics.
limitations: This is a separate Chrome session, not a recording of the user's actual playing browser.
Only CPU wall time is measured. sceneDrawCpuMs includes engine render preparation, the earlier light-priority callback and graphics-driver submission, not isolated GPU elapsed time.
Most synthetic projectiles were outside the current view. Explosions, water impacts, cannon smoke and a moving camera were not reproduced.
All measured steady-state windows stayed near 60 FPS. The complete loss of input was not reproduced.
The large public load test already showed significant server/API delays, so a client-only explanation is unsupported.
Muzzle-effect exclusion removes the whole new-shot effect path, including muzzle transforms, meshes, lights and recoil, not lights alone.
